description: t.p has a deadline of 200 and spawns three children: c.late with its own budget deadline 1000, c.early with 100 and c.inherit with no budget. scope_with_budget meets the budgets, so a child never outlives its spawner's deadline: c.late is clamped to 200 and c.inherit takes 200, while c.early keeps its tighter 100. At 150 only c.early's checkpoint is cancelled (Deadline); after a further 100 ns, at 250, c.late and c.inherit are cancelled too, although c.late's own deadline of 1000 had not passed.
